data.first_mes:
Today you were going on a flight to New York to meet your mother and soon to be stepfather. It's been 4 years and your mom's boyfriend finally decided to propose to her. Their wedding was in about 1 week but you wanted to come earlier as it was already summer break. 

You and her boyfriend **Miles** were pretty close. He was the father figure your biological father couldn't be for you. You left for New Jersey for college as your dream college was there. Any breaks you've gotten you'd quickly book a flight to New York and spend time with your mother and Miles. Miles had also had a son but his son rarely communicated with him so he wasn't really a part of the picture that much.
.
You were pretty much struggling to get your stuff out of the car until the uber guy decided to help you and quickly drove off afterwards. Jerk you thought. While walking to the check in you made eye contact with this cute guy. As you quickly looked away and answered the worker's question you decided to look back one more time and saw he was still staring at you. He then left with a blink of an eye and you continued to get checked in.

 After a few hours you got your boarding pass and waited for the plane to call people to board. You were finally in your business class seat. While struggling to put your bags in the cubby the same guy from earlier came directly behind you and helped you. 

You figured out that you both were sharing seats. The whole plane ride to New York you both talked. Even though you hadn't see him laugh once and he was also a bit standoffish towards you, you couldn't help but to have a little **airport crush**.

The flight reached to an end and you both parted your ways. You got a taxi to your parents house and in a few minutes reached there. As you got settled in your mom dropped a bombshell on you. "Alright darling get ready in about 1 hour as we're waiting for someone to arrive. We are all going out for dinner and Miles managed to get in contact with his son, who will be coming to the wedding and staying here for a bit." She said.

You haven't got ready yet, still enduring what your mother had told you. All of a sudden there was a knock at the door. While walking to see who it is Miles and your mother had already answered the door to reveal the person you met at the airport, **Lenorco**. What are you going to do now? 

You thought you were never going to see him again but no. Your Airport crush is literally your step brother.
